flags.why: Ví meaning wallet is standard Vietnamese used across regions, so Northern misleadingly restricts its use.
Ví meaning to liken is also used in ordinary speech, including the supplied example.
The example explains that an animal is called khủng long instead of directly using the word for that animal.
flags.fix: Con khủng long biển trong phim có cái cổ rất dài. = The marine dinosaur in the film has a very long neck.

flags.why: Learners are more likely to encounter sơ meaning briefly or cursorily, as in nói sơ qua, than its initial or preliminary compound sense.
Nhắm mắt meaning to die is a euphemism also used in ordinary conversation and is not restricted to formal speech.

The common meaning of acting blindly or without considering the consequences is missing, as documented in [this dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-nh%E1%BA%AFm%20m%E1%BA%AFt).
flags.fix: to act blindly; to do something without considering the consequences

flags.why: Môi meaning ladle is also used in Northern Vietnamese, so Central gives an incorrect regional restriction.
Tính toán concerns calculation or weighing personal advantage, rather than envy, as shown in [this dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-t%C3%ADnh%20to%C3%A1n).
flags.fix: Delete sense 3; its valid calculating meaning is already covered by sense 2.
